Its core IT infrastructure includes centralized data centers in Singapore and Frankfurt, which host customer transaction databases, mobile

subject: Information Systems Audit
text: banking applications, and compliance management systems. Situation: Recently, the organization’s internal audit report revealed gaps in IT governance and business continuity planning (BCP) The IT governance framework lacked alignment with corporate strategy and regulatory obligations. A network outage in Frankfurt caused a temporary suspension of online transactions, affecting over 10,000 customers for nearly 6 hours. Moreover, SecureBank’s data backup procedures were inconsistent across departments, and there was no clearly defined recovery time objective (RTO) or recovery point objective (RPO) for critical services. The Board of Directors instructed the Chief Information Officer (CIO) to establish a unified IT Governance and Business Continuity Framework, ensuring regulatory compliance (Basel III, GDPR) and operational resilience. Objectives: •   Aligning IT Governance with corporate objectives and regulatory requirements. •   Establish a comprehensive Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan (BCP/DRP) •   Minimize service downtime and ensure customer data protection. •   Define RTO and RPO for mission-critical systems. •   Evaluate maturity of IT processes to continuously improve resilience.
